description: Checks a proof of a stamp (the JSON that north_stamp returns in state "stamped", or a proof file of polarka-agent): that the path leads from the SHA-256 to the root, that the transaction carries the root, that the block holds the transaction, and with Polarka's node that this block is in the TrueNorth chain. Answers valid true with the block, its time and depth, or valid false with the reason. It is Polarka's server asking Polarka's node: to check without trusting Polarka, use polarka-agent stamp-verify with a node of your own.

proof.description: the proof, as north_stamp returned it

name: north_stamp_verify
title: Check a proof of a stamp
